title.ja: タクシーで行き先を伝える
title.en: Telling a taxi driver where to go

summary.ja: 行き先を伝えて、時間や料金を聞き、降りる場所を伝える。
summary.en: Say where you're going, ask about time and price, and say where to stop.

setting: A taxi in a city abroad, on a Sunday morning. The passenger gets in outside the Park Lane Hotel downtown. A city marathon is on today, so some roads are closed.

roles.persona: A Japanese traveller taking a taxi from their hotel.

levels.tutor: You are the taxi driver. Speak slowly, in short simple sentences. Ask where they want to go, and answer simply using the map (City Museum: about 15 minutes, about $18). You take cards.

hints: 行き先を伝えましょう
To the …, please.
To the City Museum, please.
どのくらいかかるか聞きましょう
How long does …?
How long does it take?

title.ja: カードで払えるか聞く
title.en: Ask if you can pay by card

hints: カードで払えるか聞きましょう
Can I pay by …?
Can I pay by card?

title.ja: ここで降りると伝える

hints: ここで止めてほしいと伝えましょう
Here is …, thank you.
Here is fine, thank you.

levels.tutor: You are the taxi driver, speaking at natural pace with a little small talk (is this your first time here?). Use the map for times and prices. Traffic is a bit heavy today because of the marathon, so trips take about five minutes longer.

title.ja: 行き先と通りの名前を伝える

hints: 行き先と通りの名前を伝えましょう
Could you take me to …, on …?
Could you take me to Riverside Market, on Water Street?
だいたいの時間を聞きましょう
About how long will …?
About how long will it take?
だいたいの料金を聞きましょう
Roughly how much …?
Roughly how much will it be?
降りたい場所を伝えましょう
Could you stop at …, please?
Could you stop at the main entrance, please?

levels.tutor: You are a friendly, chatty taxi driver, speaking at natural speed. It's 9:35: the museum is about 15 minutes away, plus a few minutes of marathon traffic, so you should just make it by ten. Chat about the city and give local tips when asked (Riverside Market is great for lunch). Use the map for times and prices, and give them a receipt if they ask.

title.ja: 行き先と到着したい時間を伝える
title.en: Say where and when to arrive

hints: 行き先と、何時までに着きたいか伝えましょう
I need to be at … by … Will we …?
I need to be at the City Museum by ten. Will we make it?

title.ja: 地元のおすすめを聞く

hints: 近くでおすすめの食事場所を聞きましょう
Is there anywhere good to … near …?
Is there anywhere good to eat near the museum?

title.ja: 降りる場所を詳しく伝える

hints: どこで降りたいか、詳しく伝えましょう
Could you drop me at …?
Could you drop me at the main entrance, please?

title.ja: 支払いとレシートをお願いする
title.en: Pay and ask for a receipt

hints: カードで払って、レシートをお願いしましょう
Could I pay by … and get …?
Could I pay by card and get a receipt, please?

twist.tutor: As you get close, say the road to the museum's main entrance is closed for the marathon. Offer two options: go the long way round (about 10 more minutes and $5 more), or drop them at the side entrance, a five-minute walk away.

hints: どちらにするか決めて伝えましょう
In that case, I'll …
In that case, I'll walk from the side entrance.

roles.persona: A taxi driver who knows the city well.

levels.tutor: You are a traveller going to the City Museum. Speak slowly and simply, and wait for the driver to ask you things. Ask how long it takes and how much it is.

hints: 行き先を聞きましょう
Hi! Where …?
Hi! Where would you like to go?
かかる時間を伝えましょう
About … minutes.
About 15 minutes.
料金を伝えましょう
That's … dollars, please.
That's 18 dollars, please.

levels.tutor: You are a traveller going to Riverside Market, speaking at natural pace. Say it's on Water Street, ask how long it will take, and ask whether you can pay by card.

hints: 行き先を聞きましょう
Where are you …?
Where are you heading today?
行き先を確認しましょう
… on Water Street, right?
Riverside Market on Water Street, right?

title.ja: 時間と道の混み具合を伝える

hints: 時間と混み具合を伝えましょう
It's about … The traffic is …
It's about 15 minutes. The traffic is a bit heavy today.
カードで払えると伝えましょう
Yes, card is … You can tap …
Yes, card is fine. You can tap it here.

levels.tutor: You are a traveller in a hurry to get to the City Museum by ten, speaking at natural speed. It's 9:35; ask whether you'll make it. Ask for a lunch recommendation nearby. When the road is closed, choose to walk from the side entrance.

hints: 間に合うかどうか答えましょう
We should get there by … if …
We should get there by 9:50 if the traffic is okay.

title.ja: 地元のおすすめを伝える

hints: 近くのおすすめの場所を伝えましょう
You should try … It's great for …
You should try Riverside Market. It's great for lunch.
謝って、通行止めを伝えましょう
Sorry, the road to … is closed for …
Sorry, the road to the main entrance is closed for the marathon.
遠回りするか、横の入口で降りるか提案しましょう
I can go …, or drop you …
I can go the long way round, or drop you at the side entrance.

prop.title: DOWNTOWN MAP
prop.foot: Taxis take cards · tipping 10–15% is common
